_meta._note: User asked for privacy benchmarks on 2026 frontier models. Strict-attribution research found NO dedicated privacy benchmark (PrivacyLens/PrivacyBench/IAPP/MASK) has published per-model scores for Claude Opus 4.5/4.6/4.7/Mythos, GPT-5.4/5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4, Qwen 3.6, Kimi K2.6, Muse Spark. Closest verifiable proxy: Anthropic Gray Swan ART benchmark which evaluates 4 attack categories — 'breaching confidentiality' (privacy-relevant), 'introducing competing objectives', 'generating prohibited content', 'executing prohibited actions'. Reported as composite prompt-injection ASR. Adding Browser-use Best-of-N ASR table (Opus 4.6 system card §5.2.2.3 Table 5.2.2.3.A) which includes confidentiality breach as one of 4 ART categories.
